After fishing they set aside 1 kg from their catch into the reserve; if they cannot, the missing amount is deducted from their next catch. The reserve is monitored weekly; if it falls below 30 kg the lake must be replenished with a communal catch. Failure to deposit results in a 1 kg penalty on the next trip.
agent_7.reasoning: I keep the cap low enough to protect the fish so I can keep surviving, but the 1 kg deposit keeps the lake healthy for the community and prevents over‑fishing. The 5% rule preserves a base of fish, and the skip rule stops the lake from collapsing, ensuring I have a steady supply and the community can maintain the resource.

A 20% deposit and a 10% untouched rule keep the lake healthy, while the mandatory rest prevents over‑fishing. The clear ledger and audit system ensures everyone follows the rule, protecting both the community and my own survival.
